stars_note: 4 stars since 6 Oct 2026: A, B (BU 1131 B, 2.3 arcsec, 0.35 M-sun; Desort et al. 2009, A&A 506, 1469), Ea (= WDS E = GJ 765 B, 116 arcsec, common proper motion) and Eb (suspected, MSC 'a,s': Gaia DR3 RUWE 6.2 and RV variability of E). MSC WDS 19364+5013: AB,E 'Cmp', A,B 'Ch,a', Ea,Eb 'a,s'; the WDS's C, D and F are optical. The system's rows are on Planetless 4+ Stars as '13 Cyg' and stay there: its only planet claim, tet Cyg b, is on Rejected candidates (tier unlikely), so it has no live planet or candidate (owner's decision, 6 Oct 2026, reversing the 4 Oct plan to move it to Multi-stars). Was 2.
sp_paragraph: Count corrected on Systems only, 2 -> 4, to match its Planetless 4+ Stars rows ('13 Cyg': A, B, Ea, Eb) and the MSC (WDS 19364+5013: AB,E Cmp; A,B Ch,a; Ea,Eb a,s; WDS C, D, F optical by proper motion). It stays on Planetless 4+ Stars, not Multi-stars: its only planet claim, tet Cyg b, is on Rejected candidates (tier unlikely, likely stellar; Desort et al. 2009, A&A 506, 1469). The owner's decision of 4 Oct to move it rested on that candidate and was reversed on 6 Oct. No values inferred.

sp_paragraph: Added to Multi-stars as a candidate host (CM Dra (AB) b on Unconfirmed); count unchanged. A and B: masses, Teff, luminosities and the orbit (P 1.268390011 d, e 0.0038, a 3.7612 R-sun = 0.01749 AU, a unit conversion) from Kalomeni & Yakut 2025, MNRAS 541, 2553 (arXiv:2507.17035), Table 4, all as published. INFERRED (orange): its projected separation, Gaia DR3 rho 26.726 arcsec x A's distance (67.2876 mas) = 397.19 AU; and its total proper motion, sqrt(pmRA^2 + pmDec^2) of Gaia DR3.
flags: Count 3 is right (MSC 16343+5710: Aa,Ab S2,E + A,B Cmp; no Gaia co-mover beyond the white dwarf). The Systems text's 'probably that white dwarf (not verified)' is now verified: Gaia DR3 1431176943768691328 = GJ 630.1 B = WD 1633+572 (SIMBAD; Gentile Fusillo 2021).

Host overrides replace the Systems row's combined 'M4.5V+M4.5V' and Teff 3214 K with component A's values (M4.5 V, 3130 K, L 0.0060, Kalomeni & Yakut 2025). The Systems L cell's note says L was inferred from R = 0.144, Teff 2749 K -- it does not match its own value 0.006, which equals the published L_A; the note looks stale.

sp_paragraph: Added to Multi-stars as a candidate host (HD 23439 A b on Unconfirmed); count unchanged. Ba: mass 0.75 M-sun from the MSC (estimated from absolute magnitude; a solar-metallicity estimate, likely high for this [Fe/H] ~ -1 star), class K3 V from Gray et al. 2003 (AJ 126, 2048), PM and source_id from Gaia DR3 231113740685855616, RV the SB1's systemic velocity (Latham et al. 2002). Bb: minimum mass 0.12 M-sun (MSC 'm'); orbit P 48.6521 d, e 0.6614, K1 10.11 km/s from Latham et al. 2002 (SB9 2326). INFERRED (orange): the Ba-Bb semi-major axis by Kepler's third law, ((0.75 + 0.12) x (48.6521/365.25)^2)^(1/3) = 0.249 AU, scaling as M_tot^(1/3) (0.236 AU at Ba = 0.62); valid for the SB1 orbit as published. INFERRED (orange): Ba's projected separation from A, Gaia DR3 rho 6.882 arcsec x A's distance (41.9035 mas) = 164.22 AU; Ba's total proper motion. The ORB6 grade-4 AB orbit (Izmailov 2019, P 2275.5 yr) is cited but not drawn.

ORB6 has a grade-4 (preliminary) AB orbit (Izmailov 2019: P 2275.5 yr, a 22.785", e 0.826). Not used: A-B is entered as 'projected' (Gaia 6.882", 164.22 AU). The owner may prefer the orbit ('semi-major axis' 22.785" / 41.9 mas = 544 AU, e 0.826).
Gaia DR3 gives 6.882" for A-B where the MSC says 7.166" ('EDR3 pos.'); the Gaia value is used.
The candidate HD 23439 A b's 45.7 d period sits near Ba-Bb's 48.65 d (Hirsch et al. 2021's own reservation); said in the host's Role in system.

sp_paragraph: Added to Multi-stars as a candidate host (GJ 654 b on Unconfirmed); count unchanged. GJ 653 = HD 154363 A: mass (FLAME 0.671 M-sun), luminosity (FLAME 0.1378 L-sun), Teff (GSP-Phot 4311 K), kinematics and source_id from Gaia DR3 4364527594192166400, as published; class K4/5 V from Stephenson 1986 (AJ 92, 139). INFERRED (orange): its projected separation, Gaia DR3 rho 184.423 arcsec x GJ 654's distance (95.5597 mas) = 1929.92 AU; its total proper motion.
flags: Count 2 is right: WDS LDS 585 AB is the pair; AC (ABT 13) has an unrelated proper motion and AD is flagged dubious; no MSC record; Gaia RUWE ~1 and small RV amplitudes for both stars. Mignon et al. 2024 subtract a local linear drift for four seasons only; their long-term model for GJ 654 is 'constant', so no hidden companion is implied.

The companion is the system's more massive star (0.671 vs 0.48 M-sun); the tab keeps GJ 654 as host because it is the candidate host. Named 'GJ 653' as in the Systems text (SIMBAD: HD 154363; GJ 654 = HD 154363 B).
